title: Bath dimension and initial entropy for closed repeated use of a quantum channel
description:
Preprint by Seth Douglas (seth.douglas@gmail.com) on the dimension and actual initial-entropy rate region of a closed device serving repeated uses of one fixed quantum channel against adaptive inputs. Includes the complete manuscript, appendices and reproducibility materials.

Scoped licenses: the manuscript, appendices, PDF and TeX are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0). Original code and accompanying software documentation are MIT-licensed. These are separate file-specific licenses, not a choice of license for every file. See LICENSE.md and LICENSES/ in the archive. The aggregate Other (Open) category represents this mixed-license package.

Lean coverage is partial: a finite quantum closing identity and six arithmetic lemmas, not the full entropy or asymptotic theorem. AI assistance is disclosed in the manuscript. No efficient circuit synthesis or AK resolution is claimed.
